slides.headline: Roadmaps create false comfort
slides.body: Following a roadmap feels like progress. But checking boxes is not the same as building things. Comfort is not growth.

slides.headline: You learn by shipping, not reading
slides.body: One project you finish teaches you more than ten tutorials you complete. Finish something small. Then do it again.

slides.headline: The roadmap you need is simpler
slides.body: Pick one language. Build one project. Show one person. Repeat. That is the whole roadmap.
